_about: lanePERF5 (2026-11-06). DARK A/B switch table for the 22.6 fps problem at Ultra. Every 'enabled' is false: installing this file changes nothing. Not read by the game; read by apply_perf5.py (merges the chosen switches into the live data files) and by the A/B runner via 'cli' (one exe serves every arm). Edit a switch ON only after the look gate (python _agents/visual_qc/look_gate.py vNN --expect none) passes that single arm. Order = ranked by expected gain per look risk.

baseline.note: v100/v101 verify, Ultra, 1080p output, renderScale 67, AMD 8060S iGPU. Low preset harness (50 pct scale, SSGI/SSR/SSAO/fog/contact off) runs 47-53 fps = ~20 ms, so the feature stack + 67 pct scale costs ~24 ms of the 44 ms.

switches.what: QualitySettings.lodBias 2.0 -> 1.4 (crack_flicker.json lodBias; QualityTiers.ApplyLod). Bias 2 forces LOD0 on world props to 2x the distance, in the colour pass AND in 2 shadow cascades.
switches.gate: look_gate 34 spots; watch far props pop and terrain silhouette (WorldFar 120-420 m is fogged)

switches.what: SSGI at half resolution (ssgiFullRes true -> false). SSGI stays on at quality 2. Full-res SSGI is the single biggest post pass on an iGPU.
switches.gate: p5 lift, contrast, character centre box; half-res can show denoise blur on edges

switches.what: Volumetric fog quality 2 (high) -> 1 (medium). Fog stays volumetric; froxel depth slices and tile budget drop.
switches.gate: doorway haze and pink-cloud check (v89 fix), banding in the fog shafts

switches.what: Door point lights (512/1024 soft shadow) cache static casters: perf_fixes A1 + A1b (shadowUpdateMode OnEnable, alwaysDrawDynamic). Fighters still redrawn each frame. Also a candidate fix for Dom's floor patch (door light soft shadow).
switches.gate: moving props must not leave frozen shadows; check log 'A1b staticCasters='; floor patch region

switches.what: Floor / terrain / plug stop casting shadows (perf_fixes A4). A floor never shadows anything visible; removes the largest casters from every cascade pass.
switches.gate: no shadow under the paving lip / stairs; verify_ground 34/34

switches.what: Sun shadow distance 40 -> 30 m (arena is z 8..22, camera ~12 m behind). Cascades stay 2 x 2048.
switches.gate: shadows on far props 30-40 m; arena frames unchanged

switches.what: HDRP async compute family on (asyncCompute 1). No picture change. On AMD can be -1..+3 ms, so A/B only.
switches.gate: fps only; keep only if p50 rises in 2 of 3 runs

switches.what: SSAO quality 1 -> 0 (SSGI already supplies occlusion at ultra).
switches.gate: contact darkening under armour and sword; contrast ratio >= 0.85x

switches.what: SSR quality 1 -> 0. Floor is rough dark stone; reflections barely read.
switches.gate: wet blood / sword spec on floor

switches.what: Bake Unity occlusion culling (laneOCCLUSION, chain.occlusion in Tools/build_config.json; occlusion.json already enabled). Culls the world dressing hidden behind the gate wall and buttresses from colour AND shadow passes. Build-time, so the build is the arm.
switches.gate: no popping when the camera moves; doorway, finisher cams and FinisherCams skip list stay un-culled; fighters never culled

switches.what: Cached directional shadows for static casters: perf_mem A2 plus HDRP asset allowDirectionalMixedCachedShadows 1 (lanePERF4 asset_variants\HDRP_Max.A2.asset). Needs P5-SHADOW-DOORS' A1b static casters.
switches.gate: sun is static; check stale cascade (shadow_fixes key_everyframe arm); acne

switches.what: Contact shadows off. Listed only so the arm exists; they carry the sword/armour grounding, so expect a look fail.

abProtocol: One exe, base arm = all dark. Per arm run the verify harness 3x interleaved (arm order rotated), idle machine, one heavy job at a time. Use p50 of steady frames (drop SLOW frame lines and the screenshot frames; the 52 'SLOW frame' lines in v101 verify startup are the load/prewarm hitches and pull the mean down). Then look_gate.py on the 34 verify frames per arm; keep an arm only if fps gain >= 0.8 AND the gate passes.
